I told Hollis in the #central-team thread that the number of record for Marrow Agrisupply is 40 seats.

- **Where 40 comes from:** the Affiliate Amendment set Agrisupply at 40 seats from 2025-10-15. The 2026 renewal (signed 22 Apr 2026, in effect from 1 May 2026, running through 30 Apr 2027) left those seats unchanged. The account page also says 40.
- **Still open:** Tobias hasn't replied to my Oct 14 question about the 382 seats he posted in the channel. I told Hollis to use 40 unless Tobias points to a newer change.

I only gave Hollis seat counts and dates, which he's allowed to see as Central team lead. I left out the prices.
